metrics.meaning: 1 only when a whole source pass completed; 0 on a failed pass, missing when the process is gone. This is page-loop liveness. It is NOT P-031 A01 PollHealthy, which requires both the vote and the moderation poll to have succeeded recently: a pass in which every conversation failed still completes
metrics.name: SourcePassHealthy

metrics.meaning: wall time of one bounded source pass
metrics.name: SourcePassSeconds

metrics.meaning: conversations visited by the pass, before shard/backoff filtering
metrics.name: SourcePassConversations

metrics.meaning: conversations whose cheap change probe was evaluated
metrics.name: SourcePassProbed

metrics.meaning: conversations the probe found unchanged, so no full source read was taken
metrics.name: SourcePassSkipped

metrics.meaning: conversations that took the authoritative full snapshot this pass
metrics.name: SourcePassReconciled

metrics.meaning: conversations that committed a new generation this pass
metrics.name: SourcePassPublished

metrics.meaning: conversations deferred this pass with durable bounded backoff
metrics.name: SourcePassDeferred

metrics.meaning: CO01 scan age: age of the oldest authoritative full source snapshot for this shard's candidates, measured from before the source read. The incremental fast path is only sound while this is bounded. It is NOT P-031 A02 PublishLagSeconds: a quiet conversation's source age grows toward the ceiling with no pending math at all
metrics.name: OldestReconciliationAgeSeconds

metrics.meaning: CO01 backlog: candidate conversations never reconciled, or overdue for reconciliation
metrics.name: ReconciliationBacklogConversations

metrics.meaning: CO01 failures: candidate conversations currently in durable backoff; a conversation this shard/allowlist would never attempt is not counted
metrics.name: FailureBacklogConversations

metrics.meaning: CO06 oldest unrepaired age: how long the oldest still-failing candidate conversation has been failing. Scoped to this shard and allowlist, like every other gauge here. Not P-031 A02
metrics.name: OldestUnrepairedAgeSeconds

metrics.meaning: per-zid probe -> source -> compute -> publish wall time
metrics.name: ConversationLatencySeconds

metrics.meaning: per-zid authoritative snapshot read time
metrics.name: SourceReadSeconds

metrics.meaning: per-zid worker compute time, worker process lifetime included
metrics.name: ComputeSeconds

metrics.meaning: per-zid publication transaction time, retries included
metrics.name: PublishSeconds

metrics.meaning: CO03 lease outcome: this owner took or renewed ownership at an epoch
metrics.name: LeaseAcquired

metrics.meaning: CO03 lease outcome: another owner holds an unexpired lease
metrics.name: LeaseUnavailable

metrics.meaning: CO03 lease outcome: this owner's own lease elapsed in database time
metrics.name: LeaseExpired

metrics.meaning: CO03 lease outcome: owner or epoch superseded; terminal for this owner
metrics.name: LeaseFenced

metrics.meaning: CO04 publication outcome: one generation committed
metrics.name: PublishCommitted

metrics.meaning: CO04 publication outcome: stale expected tick, nothing overwritten
metrics.name: PublishConflict

metrics.meaning: CO04 publication outcome: ownership refused inside the transaction
metrics.name: PublishRefused

metrics.meaning: CO04 publication outcome: whole-transaction retry after 40001/40P01
metrics.name: PublishRetried

metrics.meaning: CO04 ambiguous COMMIT attempts, counted before readback; not evidence of resolution
metrics.name: PublishUncertain

metrics.meaning: CO04 ambiguous COMMIT resolved by coherent readback of this exact operation, epoch, tick and checkpoint
metrics.name: PublishResolvedOwn

metrics.meaning: CO04 ambiguous COMMIT without proof of this operation: missing, inconsistent or superseded identity, or failed reconnect/readback. Does not prove rollback; any nonzero sum requires investigation
metrics.name: PublishUnresolvedLost

metrics.meaning: records this process failed to write; a nonzero value means the other series are incomplete
metrics.name: MetricsDropped

p031_status.note: These are local diagnostics with no deployed publisher and no delivery proof. A01 needs both poll loops to have succeeded, A02 needs initiated-but-unpublished work, and A03 needs an independent observer; none of the series below is any of those. Scope: every gauge is scoped to this shard and allowlist.

publication_readback_alarm.note: Sparse outcome events, not a heartbeat. Missing events cannot establish health or resolution; independent producer/sink observation and delivery remain required. A later resolved-own event does not cancel an earlier unresolved-lost operation.

transport: CloudWatch Embedded Metric Format records on a JSON-lines sink; no AWS client in this crate
